# Auth0: json

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Auth0 JSON flow integrations allow customizing authentication flows using JSON configuration. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: specify the exact JSON schema structure for flow customization. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: detail the OAuth/OIDC endpoint paths and required parameters for JSON flow setup. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: enumerate the exact callback URLs and response codes returned by the Auth0 JSON integration endpoints.

Search intents:
- Auth0 JSON flow configuration
- OAuth OIDC endpoint paths
- JSON schema for Auth0 flows

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/auth0-json-flows --json
